test_case.test_name: Concurrent eight-NIC, storage, GPU and DIMM load for 12 hours at 0C/-5%
test_case.purpose: Verify the full platform sustains the signed concurrent matrix at cold/low-rail margin with each NIC above its 80% floor and no data, link, accelerator, memory or platform fault.
required_package: Exact overlap plus low-rail/per-domain abort and recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions and run approved network, safe FIO, GPU and memory profiles in one exact 12-hour overlap with per-domain telemetry, then clean up, warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: Every workload meets signed load/performance/integrity limits; each NIC exceeds its own 80% floor and no disallowed data, XID/ECC/AER/RAS/SEL event occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact concurrency, all eight paths/authorized targets and full duration; aggregate throughput, staggered jobs, unsafe disks or smoke tests cannot pass.
safety_gate: Immutable storage identities and OS/mount/RAID/data protection
No auto-retry; cleanup and dry warm-up
test_case.recovery: Stop all domains coherently, preserve correlated evidence, protect affected storage, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, restore topology/services and do not auto-retry.
